FX5U-64MR/ES (32 inputs, 32 relay outputs)
FX5U-64MT/ES (32 inputs, 32 transistor sink outputs)
FX5U-64MT/ESS (32 inputs, 32 transistor source outputs)
FX5U-80MR/ES (40 inputs, 40 relay outputs)
FX5U-80MT/ES (40 inputs, 40 transistor sink outputs)
FX5U-80MT/ESS (40 inputs, 40 transistor source outputs)

DC power supply models:

FX5U-32MR/DS (16 inputs, 16 relay outputs)
FX5U-32MT/DS (16 inputs, 16 transistor sink outputs)
FX5U-32MT/DSS (16 inputs, 16 transistor source outputs)
FX5U-64MR/DS (32 inputs, 32 relay outputs)
FX5U-64MT/DS (32 inputs, 32 transistor sink outputs)
FX5U-64MT/DSS (32 inputs, 32 transistor source outputs)
FX5U-80MR/DS (40 inputs, 40 relay outputs)
FX5U-80MT/DS (40 inputs, 40 transistor sink outputs)
FX5U-80MT/DSS (40 inputs, 40 transistor source outputs)

The naming convention follows this pattern:

The number (32/64/80) indicates the total number of I/O points
MR indicates relay outputs
MT indicates transistor outputs
ES indicates AC power supply
DS indicates DC power supply
ESS indicates AC power supply with source type transistor outputs
DSS indicates DC power supply with source type transistor outputs

queries.question: Can you tell me about the communication ports in FX5U-32MT/ES?
queries.our_answer:
The FX5U-32MT/ES is an FX5U CPU module [Source 6]. Based on the provided context, the communication ports and capabilities for FX5U CPU modules include:

*   **Built-in Communication Ports:**
    *   **Ethernet:** The FX5U CPU module is standard equipped with a built-in Ethernet port and supports built-in Ethernet functions such as connection with MELSOFT products and GOT, socket communications, file transfer (FTP server, FTP client), Web server (HTTP), SNTP client, and simple CPU communication [Source 11, Source 12].
    *   **RS-485:** The FX5U CPU module has a built-in RS-485 port. Its specifications include conformance to RS-485/RS-422 standards, a maximum data transmission speed of 115.2 kbps, full-duplex (FDX) / half-duplex (HDX) communication method, and a maximum total extension distance of 50 m. It supports various protocol types like MELSOFT connection, Non-protocol communication, MELSEC communication protocol, MODBUS RTU, Predefined protocol support, Inverter communication, N:N network, and Parallel link. It is not insulated and has built-in terminal resistors (OPEN/110 Ω /330 Ω) [Source 10, Source 12].
    *   **SD Memory Card Slot:** The FX5U CPU module is equipped with an SD memory card slot [Source 12].

*   **Expandable Communication Options:**
    *   The FX5U CPU module allows for system expansion using expansion boards and expansion adapters [Source 12].
    *   **RS-232C:** An expansion board (FX5-232-BD) or an expansion adapter (FX5-232ADP) is required for RS-232C communications [Source 7, Source 9, Source 12]. The FX5-232ADP supports RS-232C standard compliant transmission with a maximum distance of 15m [Source 5].
    *   **RS-485/RS-422 (via adapter):** An expansion adapter (FX5-485ADP) can be used for RS-485 and RS-422 standards compliant transmission, with a maximum distance of 1200m [Source 5, Source 9, Source 12].

*   **USB:** The FX5U CPU module does not have a built-in USB port [Source 12].
